name: @tpmjs/tools-neon
description: Neon serverless Postgres tools for AI agents. Manage projects, branches, databases, endpoints, and usage metrics.

tools.name: listProjects
tools.description: List all Neon projects with optional search filtering.

tools.name: getProject
tools.description: Get details of a specific Neon project by ID.

tools.name: createProject
tools.description: Create a new Neon project with a default branch and database.

tools.name: deleteProject
tools.description: Permanently delete a Neon project and all its resources.

tools.name: listBranches
tools.description: List all branches in a Neon project.

tools.name: createBranch
tools.description: Create a new branch from a parent branch in a Neon project.

tools.name: deleteBranch
tools.description: Delete a branch from a Neon project.

tools.name: listDatabases
tools.description: List all databases on a specific branch.

tools.name: createDatabase
tools.description: Create a new database on a branch.

tools.name: deleteDatabase
tools.description: Delete a database from a branch.

tools.name: listEndpoints
tools.description: List compute endpoints for a Neon project.

tools.name: suspendEndpoint
tools.description: Suspend a running compute endpoint to save costs.

tools.name: getConnectionUri
tools.description: Get a PostgreSQL connection string for a database.

tools.name: listOperations
tools.description: List recent operations for a Neon project.

tools.name: getConsumption
tools.description: Get usage metrics (compute time, storage, data written) for a date range.
